newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot jet up with NYMEX, diffs gain modestly.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot jet up with NYMEX, diffs gain modestly.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices moved higher Wednesday on the back of the late NYMEX rally, as well as firmness in the differentials.
Traders attributed the jump in NYMEX heating oil prices to short covering ahead of the expiration of the December contract.
New York Harbor prompt aviation-grade jet fuel firmed slightly to about 3.25 cents over the screen, while low sulphur 55-grade was put at 4.40 cents over NYMEX.
U.S. Gulf aviation-grade jet fuel reversed some late Tuesday weakness, trading at 0.50 cents under the NYMEX.
